column1: Complete system installation accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics Field Supervisor. (See signed Contractor Field Check List).
At night and together with the commissioning manager, check for sufficient task lighting levels in all areas of the plant.  Add lights where absolutely required or move lights if required.
Also at night, trip the power supplied to all lights and observe the proper actuation of all the emergency lights.
Adjust the individual beams to suit local conditions.

Re-energize power supply and observe the correct locations and operation of the Quartz restart lamp equipped HID fixtures.
Note:  After approx. seven (7) minutes all HID lights should be fully “on”.
Test all lighting circuits by individually turning “off” and “on”.
Check lighting system in control room.  (Lights, switches, dimmers any receptacles as well as proper reflectors).
Check for glare on CRT’s. (Many combinations possible).
